authentication: Existing CONNECT gate and report identity/ownership checks; assigned administrative profiles additionally restrict report actions

parameters.download: 1 for raw complete attachment; any other supplied value rejected (422)

success.body: Exact stored payload_json bytes, no re-encoding

errors.404: missing report or other owner without existing global read permission
errors.503: stored payload not a report object with observations array

content.photos: sum of observation photos plus one when contexte_exterieur.photo is an object

unconfirmed.message: Keep draft; verify stored copy before retry

import.required: Report object with observations array, or API envelope report.payload
import.independence: Remove onlineReportId only; preserve internal business ids and references
import.structureMarker: copie_test === true; strict historical test copy also detected
import.editingLimit: Unsafe JavaScript integers rejected before editing; raw download remains exact

profileActions.export: GET complete download=1; POST auth.php?action=authorize-export for official browser downloads/sharing
profileActions.source: private CONNECT policy for authenticated account, never submitted report JSON
profileActions.limits: Official UI paths only; already-read data and downloaded files cannot be recalled

observationPlans.images: Embedded PNG/JPEG only; existing size/dimension limits unchanged
observationPlans.captureMetadata: Optional cadrage.mode, capturedAt, center, zoom, bounds; source and date embedded in capture
observationPlans.markers: Stable observation id and planId, normalized x/y per view; no automatic copying
observationPlans.removeView: Explicit confirmation; remove that view and its markers only
